from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        seq = operator.Sequential(
            llm=self.llm,
            num_rounds=3,
            prompts=[
                prompt_custom.SUDOKU_SOLVE_PROMPT,
                prompt_custom.SUDOKU_AUDIT_PROMPT,
                prompt_custom.SUDOKU_FINALIZE_PROMPT,
            ],
        )
        solution = await seq(problem)
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }

class prompt_custom:
    SUDOKU_SOLVE_PROMPT = """Solve the Sudoku carefully. Fill every dot with a digit 1-9 while preserving all given clues exactly. Produce a complete candidate 9x9 board."""

    SUDOKU_AUDIT_PROMPT = """Audit the Sudoku candidate below and repair it if needed.

{previous_output}

Check all constraints simultaneously:
- each row contains digits 1-9 exactly once
- each column contains digits 1-9 exactly once
- each 3x3 subgrid contains digits 1-9 exactly once
- all original clues from the problem remain unchanged

If any entry causes a conflict, revise the board to remove conflicts and produce a fully solved board.
Output only a plain 9-line board using digits separated by single spaces. No code block and no extra text."""

    SUDOKU_FINALIZE_PROMPT = """Convert the audited Sudoku board below into the final answer format and make one last correction if any constraint is still violated.

{previous_output}

Return only the final solved Sudoku in a fenced code block with exactly 9 lines, each line containing 9 digits separated by single spaces. No extra text."""
